CF-C Port 1: CapControl Type=follow ControlSignal=LoadShape. Daily walk over the 24-pt Cap1Shape/Cap2Shape; the two banks switch on the loadshape schedule (cap1 hour 9 ON / hour 24 OFF; cap2 hour 14 ON). check_meters_monitors compares the Cap1Mon/Cap2Mon power channels per step (0 when the bank is open, nonzero when closed), which pins the FOLLOW switching schedule against the oracle. compare_eventlog is intentionally NOT used: the deck runs its own full-day `Solve` at compile (eventlog off), so a post-compile eventlog starts mid-trajectory and the arm/fire step boundary is logged asymmetrically vs the from-scratch oracle run — the switching itself is validated by the monitor power channels and the full per-step voltage compare. Pinned oracle supports FOLLOWCONTROL (not a target-rev feature).

CF-C Port 2: Storage.Store1 sets DynaDLL/DynaData for a user-written dynamics model DLL that is NOT vendored. Safe Rust never loads DLLs (loader out of scope), so the port warns (non-fatal, #1570-class) and falls back to the built-in model — exactly the official Direct DLL. The pinned oracle raises #1570 (fatal), so this gates vs r3723, which warns and solves. Rust iter 2 == r3723 iter 2 (T-A #19).
CF-C Port 2: 1-phase twin of SimpleStorageTest — same DynaDLL/DynaData warn+fallback surface, gated vs r3723 (pinned raises #1570). Rust iter 2 == r3723 iter 2 (T-A #20).

CF2-R: #485 control-settling. This interconnected IEEE_123 model has no Solve of its own; the harness solve exceeds MaxControlIter=10 (a regulator hunts +/-1 tap at a band edge, never draining the control queue) and aborts with #485 on BOTH engines. Proven identical to the official r3723 (Oddie): all 7 RegControl taps + 4 cap states exact, node V to 8e-9 rel over 278 nodes, same 10 control iters / 30 total iters. The pinned oracle raises #485; Rust reproduces SolutionAbort + the same message 1:1. Not a bug (the earlier 'different trajectory' note was a measurement artifact: Rust first-solve vs oracle re-solve).

Flipped to oracle:capi015 by the DYNEXP WP (D14, upstream 2a8bdb78). This deck runs a full dynamics swing (fault at HT, cleared by opening a line, 5 s undamped swing) driven by a DynamicExp shaft model. D14 makes SolveEq a no-op evaluator, so the rotor stays frozen at its seed angle (theta 0.72907156 rad, speed 0) instead of swinging -- matching capi015 exactly, diverging from the 0.14.5 oracle (which swings). See DIVERGENCES.md §D14 and the generator_dynexp_dynamics_* unit gates. The steady-state-only sibling stays on the default oracle (never enters dynamics, so SolveEq is never called).

Flipped to oracle:capi015 by WP-U1.6 D12 (SwtControl Normal/State field mapping, bb9c9785). SwtControl.5_11 is created `Action=c` then `edit action=o`; under D12 (matching capi015) `Normal` reads NormalState=closed (unchanged by the Action edit), while 0.14.5 read the shared CurrentAction=open -- a deliberate readback mismatch (§1.2). Snapshot deck, so no multi-step concern; capi015==0.14.5 on civanlar physics (no loadshapes/seasonal/growth), so the whole-model V/Y/power compare is unchanged -- only the property readback moves, and target-rev cases do not property-compare (the SwtControl Normal/State readback is pinned by the swtcontrol_time/midi_swtcontrol capi015 decks + swt_control unit tests). See DIVERGENCES.md §D12.

CF2-R: #485 control-settling. The deck's own Solve settles clean at 67 iters; the harness's second solve re-runs the control loop from the settled taps, a regulator re-arms at a band edge and hunts, exceeding MaxControlIter=10 -> #485 abort on BOTH engines. Proven identical to the official r3723 (Oddie): all 12 RegControl taps + 10 cap states exact, node V to 5.5e-11 rel over 8531 nodes, same 10 control iters / 109 total iters. Pinned oracle raises #485 on the re-solve; Rust reproduces SolutionAbort + the same message 1:1. The 'Rust 67 clean vs r3723 109 #485' note was a measurement artifact (Rust first-solve vs oracle re-solve).

CF-B migration (T-A #29). The pinned oracle raises #303 on the deck's headless `Show` commands; the official EPRI engines treat them as non-fatal and solve through, matching Rust -- validated live through the harness via the Oddie bridge (full-model compare green). Rust compiles the whole deck (Show/Export/fileedit are headless no-ops) with zero errors; the gated final solve is the deck's Direct-mode SLG-fault-at-B2 (loads disabled) solve. Re-gated r3723 -> r4088 at the upgrade-rung1 sync merge: the deck is 4Bus Carson geometry, and WP-U1.2 B2/D1 (SimpleCarson De 658.5 -> 658.8530451057239, DIVERGENCES.md #b2--d1) moved Rust off the r3723-era constant (witnessed 5.7e-6 > 1.04e-6 floor); r4088 carries the corrected LineConstants (ledger: byte-identical across r4088/r4133) while keeping the non-fatal-Show behavior.

CF-B migration (T-A #27). Pinned oracle raises #303 on headless `Show`; r3723 solves through, matching Rust -- validated live. The gated final state is the deck's SECOND `Compile ieee34Mod1.dss` run: forced regulator taps + `Set Controlmode=OFF`, i.e. a plain power flow with no control loop. Rust iterations == r3723 there (no fewer-iteration NOTE emitted). Iteration caveat reconciled: the triage's Rust-4-vs-r3723-2 was the FIRST (controlled) run's control-iteration count, NOT the like-for-like gated final solve the harness compares -- so the Rust<=oracle policy is not actually violated.

Whole-IEEE123 GFM daily->dynamics trajectory (cannot-pick-up-load: Load.s103c.kW=400 collapses the island so the GFM storage cannot form voltage); floating-delta common-mode floor. GFM WP re-promotion (was parked upgrade_straddle_gfm_wp). Islanded GFM daily->dynamics deck (sw5 open, storage GFM discharge). The 0.15.x GFM Storage YPrim delta (B5: Isc1 drops the *1000 factor, dss_capi de6a5a42 = SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) is now ported, moving the assembled system Y at the StoBus mutuals to the capi015 value (witnessed Y[STOBUS.1,STOBUS.2] 0.14.5 vs capi015 rel 1.209e-1). Straddle-axis (1) WP-U1.2 D7 (PVSystem dynamics iMaxPPhase PanelkW->FkVArating) is also resolved on capi015. Whole-model live compare (system Y + V/I/P per step) green vs capi015; the GFM power-flow op-point is Isc1-invariant (proven), so V/I/P did not move -- only the Norton YPrim did.

GFM WP re-promotion (was parked upgrade_straddle_gfm_wp). Current-limited (AmpLimit=500) islanded GFM daily->dynamics deck; same class as its GFM_IEEE123/GFMDaily sibling. B5 (Isc1 drop *1000, de6a5a42/SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) moves the assembled system Y at the StoBus mutuals to capi015 (witnessed rel 1.209e-1). The storage dynamics state var it[last] is an open-loop, non-injecting integration (only it[0] drives the GFM voltage source), so it drifts on the oscillating AC waveform over the long trajectory; it is not a gated quantity and does not affect node V, which stays pinned by the it[0]<->node-V fixpoint. Whole-model live compare green vs capi015.

CF2-G migration. Whole-IEEE123 GFL daily→dynamics trajectory (Storage+PV, InvControl GFM monitor). Was ABOVE-BAND; root cause fixed: PVSystem InitStateVars/IntegrateStates ignored 'Set LoadShapeClass=daily' in dynamics (PanelkW 800 vs oracle 594.78), diverging node V ~16 V at the PV region. Fix honors ActiveLoadShapeClass in dynamics per PVsystem.pas l.2192/l.2281. Flipped oracle:capi015 at the upgrade-rung1 sync merge: WP-U1.2 D7 (PVSystem dynamics iMaxPPhase PanelkW -> FkVArating, DIVERGENCES.md #d7) moves this deck -- the daily shape puts PanelkW (irradiance-scaled, ~594.78 kW) below FkVArating (800), so the dynamics current limit differs between the engines (U1.2's kVA=Pmpp snapshot no-op probe does not apply mid-shape); vs 0.14.5 the trajectory diverged 7.61e-4 > 7.44e-4 floor (witnessed at merge), vs capi015 it is within floors.

CF2-G migration; re-promoted from skipped_needs_investigation by the DYNEXP WP (D14 pulled ahead of WP-U1.6). GFL daily->dynamics DynamicExp/DynamicEq/DynOut variant of the GFL sibling. Double attribution off both mid-rung engines: (1) WP-U1.2 D7 (PVSystem dynamics iMaxPPhase PanelkW -> FkVArating, DIVERGENCES.md #d7) moved it off the 0.14.5 oracle (witnessed 7.62e-4 > 7.41e-4 floor at entry 118); (2) the 0.15.x DynamicExp delta D14 (upstream 2a8bdb78) kept it off capi015 (witnessed 8.31e-3 > 7.40e-4 at entry 0). D14 ported: SolveEq now exits before evaluating the RHS (no-op evaluator; state-var derivative frozen at InitStateVars), so the DynExp path matches capi015 -- witnessed live: Generator dspeed=0/speed frozen vs 0.14.5 dspeed=-1.6e-6 (DIVERGENCES.md §D14). With D7 (landed) + D14 (this WP) both porting, the deck is capi015-green.

Flipped oracle:capi015 by the GFM WP: the 8500-node GFM snapshot leaves its GFM storage discharging, so the B5 Isc1 change (drop *1000, dss_capi de6a5a42 = SVN r3865; DIVERGENCES.md #b5) moves the assembled system Y at the StoBus mutuals (witnessed 0.14.5 vs capi015 rel 1.172e-1). Its GFMDaily/GFMDailySmallerPV siblings end charging/GFL and stay 0.14.5-green. Whole-model live compare green vs capi015.
